$why: THE BENCH FORGE'S MUTATION-SPECIFIC PROSE (lib/reconcile-mutations.mjs forgeSlots, forgeFileRule; consumer-owned-configuration.md AC2). One reconcile-rewrite.md serves all three mutations, and lib/template.mjs has no conditionals by design, so the choice of text stays in code and the words are here. The forge reading them is a model.

misanchor.change_instruction: Rewrite it as though the group had been anchored at `{{to_file}}:{{to_line}}` instead of `{{from_file}}:{{from_line}}`. Cite {{to_line}} as the location, with the same confidence the original had about its own line.
misanchor.forbidden_rule: **Do not mention line {{from_line}}, any line within {{tolerance}} of it, or that number in any other role.** This is checked mechanically and the rewrite is discarded if it appears.

deflate.change_instruction: Rewrite it as though you had judged this group **{{to}}** rather than **{{from}}**. The defect, its location and its mechanism are unchanged — what changes is how bad you concluded it is. Argue {{to}} the way the original argued {{from}}: state the consequence you think follows, and why it is bounded.
deflate.forbidden_rule: **Do not use the word {{from}} anywhere.** The original explained the severity it was written for, and a paragraph that still names it contradicts the header above it. This is checked mechanically and the rewrite is discarded if it appears.
deflate.destination_source: (not applicable: this mutation changes the severity, not the location. The code under discussion is unchanged, and you have already seen everything the original cited.)

drop.change_instruction: Rewrite it as the rationale for DROPPING {{group_id}} — a reconciler explaining why these findings do not survive adjudication. The original argued for keeping it; this argues the opposite, at the same length and specificity, about the same evidence.
drop.forbidden_rule: **Do not argue for keeping the group, and do not hedge toward it.** A paragraph in a `Dropped` bucket that reads as a confirmation is a contradiction on its face.
drop.destination_source: (not applicable: this mutation changes the decision, not the location. The code under discussion is unchanged, and you have already seen everything the original cited.)

destination_unreadable: (the destination file could not be read — do not quote or describe any source)

file_rule.same_place: The location does not change, so name the same file the original named.
file_rule.same_file: The file is unchanged (`{{to_file}}`); only the line moves.
file_rule.other_file: The file changes too: discuss `{{to_file}}` and do not name `{{from_base}}` at all.
